description: What this server keeps about the caller: the hash its credits are counted under, the rate limit left in this hour and the privacy policy. For a Pro key, which vendor keys are stored and a 15-minute link to change them.
name: privacy_my_data

charged.description: Credits this call cost; 0 for a free tool.

remaining.description: Credits left in the budget window. Absent when not paid from a credit budget.

key_expires_at.description: Unix seconds when the API key stops working. null off the pro tier and for a key that never expires.

key_expires_at_utc.description: key_expires_at as UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. null when key_expires_at is null. null when it cannot be written as a date.

policy.description: The privacy policy page. It says what the server keeps and for how long.

hourly_limit.description: Credits the budget holds for one hour.

resets_at.description: Unix seconds when the budget resets.

resets_at_utc.description: resets_at as UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. null when it cannot be written as a date.

resets_in.description: Time left until the reset, as HH:MM:SS.

stored.description: What the server stores to count this call's credits.

hash.description: The hash that meters this call's credits.

metered_by.description: ip_hmac without an API key, key_sha256 with one.

tier.description: free without an API key, pro with an active one.

upgrade_url.description: The page that sells a Pro key. null on the pro tier.

vendor_keys.description: Which vendor keys ip_lookup can use. null off the pro tier.

manage_url.description: A link to the page that saves or deletes the vendor keys. It works as a credential for 15 minutes, so do not log or share it. null when the state could not be read.

configured.description: true when the API key stores a key for this vendor. null when the state could not be read.

title: Privacy: My Data
